resolution.quote: I recall seeing that warning when testing, and am OK with the fix in #722 to not enable it.

notes: Issue body verbatim confirms the warning text and the refusal error; the maintainer comment verbatim confirms awareness. The refused attribute is the QoS history kind/depth (keep-last with depth 0) on the intra-process path, which the listed QoS classes (reliability/durability/deadline) do not cover, so class `other` is correct. loudness loud_documented is correct: rclcpp throws at component construction (activation), a runtime-enforced refusal rather than a silent failure. Resolution `none` is correct: PR #2752 only deletes the misleading warning, leaving SystemDefaultsQoS in place, so the refused composition still fails when intra-process is enabled; there is no change that makes the composition work.
